title: Phantom Blade Zero Missable Content - What You Can Permanently Skip
description: Community documentation states plainly that some side quests cannot be recovered once missed. This page separates what is actually known from what is guess, and gives a route that keeps the recoverable stuff safe.

sections.title: What is actually known, and what is not
sections.content:
One line in the community wiki is worth more than any other pre-release sentence: 部分支线任务错过后无法挽回 - some side quests cannot be recovered once missed. That is a real warning, and it is the reason this page exists.

What nobody has, before launch, is the list. No outlet or wiki has published which quests are missable, where the points of no return are, or which quests lock behind a chapter. Anyone publishing a specific missable list before reviewers have the retail build is guessing, and this page will not pretend otherwise.

sections.title: Why this game makes it sharper than usual
sections.content:
Three confirmed design choices stack the risk:

  • Side quests can open new story paths. S-GAME's own State of Play post says interacting with people and completing some side quests may open paths through the story. So a missed quest is potentially a missed branch, not just missed loot.
  • There are reportedly eight endings. If endings are driven by side content and collection, a missable quest is an ending you may not see on this run.
  • Exploration is gated by weapons. Some areas need a specific Phantom Edge to reach, so an area you skip is a set of quests you never saw the existence of.

sections.title: The route that keeps you safe
sections.content:
Until a real list exists, the only defensible approach is procedural:

  1. Watch the map percentage, not the quest markers. The game tracks totals per area, so a map that stops climbing is telling you something.
  2. Clear 庞镇 / Pang Town before advancing a chapter. The hub is where the NPC-linked quests live, and the community notes say some side quests are tied to Pang Town NPCs. Hub state is usually the first thing a chapter transition invalidates.
  3. Take every Phantom Edge you find, even if you do not use it - it may be the key to a region rather than a weapon.
  4. Pick a difficulty you can actually finish with. The director's stated reason for moving the death limit into 66 Days was that a countdown on the first run was too harsh. That is an explicit invitation to play the story first and the challenge second.
  5. Plan on a second run. New Game Plus carries weapons and upgrades, and the late-game arsenal is designed to be used there.

sections.title: New Game Plus is part of the plan, not a consolation prize
sections.content:
The director has been direct about why NG+ exists: weapons that drop from late, final and hidden bosses arrive with so little of the campaign left that on a first run they are collectibles. They were built out in full anyway, with more motion capture and more involved mechanics than the early weapons.

So a first run that misses content is not a failure state - it is the intended shape. Clearing the game on Pathbreaker or Hellwalker also unlocks 66 Days, which means finishing the story is a prerequisite for the hardest mode rather than a warm-up for it.

Community terminology and structure on this page comes from the 影之刃 WIKI on BWIKI, a fan wiki maintained by the moderators of the 影之刃 Baidu Tieba, which states it has no affiliation with S-GAME. It was last edited 2026-10-13 and much of it is still marked 待补充 (to be filled in). Anything taken from it is labelled as community-sourced rather than official, and counts will be replaced with measured data after release.
